# Yang--Mills representational dynamics: 2026-07-21 import

This directory preserves a user-supplied research bundle as target-specific
external evidence.  It does not establish authorship, ownership, an upstream
repository, or a license: all four remain unknown.  Archive integrity proves
only which bytes were supplied.

## Three trust layers

1. `source_archives/` contains the byte-for-byte archive.  Its SHA-256 is
   `d34b5daca880bed58e2fa908d7dbaa137c55b9f1980b89dcdc26498528e7492f`.
2. `active_snapshot/` is a read-only safe extraction retaining the complete
   meaningful sibling layout. Python caches, build byproducts, and nested
   archives stay only in the raw archive and are excluded from the active
   index.
3. `normalized/` contains Abducer judgments: source-bound Stage 52/78/79
   evidence, the incumbent H1--H10 portfolio, the dated provider-backed
   literature rebase, central-schema snapshot and assimilation adapters, the
   conceptual assessment, publication quarantine, Stage 70 qualification, and
   the aggressive external-rival portfolio.

The immutable manifest and its `.sha256` lock bind the first two layers.  The
upstream `install_skills.py` was not run.

## Epistemic interpretation

The bundle makes valuable finite/restricted results and negative knowledge
more explicit, but its ten source streams mostly elaborate one
retained-kernel/relational-rigidity/block-RG programme.  They are incumbent
evidence, not sufficient conceptual plurality.  Abducer therefore keeps the
reflective conceptual loop as parent, activates exactly three guarded
constructive skills, reuses seventeen existing YM skills, and leaves ten
publication skills external-only.

`normalized/aggressive_rival_portfolio.json` supplies nine structurally
external theory seeds plus one conservative incumbent control.  It keeps
truth probability, value if right, learning if false, and maturation cost
separate; preserves three low-confidence wildcards; and provides isolated
branch seeds for four-worker, conflict-preserving parallel maturation.

The dated packet records a real, bounded provider-backed browser capture with
exact providers, indexes, queries, retrieval sessions, source versions, and
transfer limits.  It is explicitly non-exhaustive and is not peer validation.
In particular, arXiv:2606.19362 is retained as an
`unverified_challenger`: its six abstract-level construction claims create six
claim-by-claim audit obligations and reprioritize theory collisions, but prove
nothing here.

The adapter emits `normalized/canonical_target_literature_snapshot.json` and
`normalized/canonical_literature_assimilation_packet.json`, both validated
against the central literature contracts.  Their canonical provenance remains
`local_only`, their hypothesis rebase is `provisional_local_only`, and their
active-investment gate is `blocked_local_only`.  Browser retrieval did not
produce executable search-operator receipts, so hand-entered provenance fields
cannot authorize novelty, theorem promotion, truth selection, or active
investment.  Every later target cycle must rerun the hook for its coverage date
and bind the result to the exact canonical theory-state digest.

## Replay result

The stage-isolated harness discovered 72 test files in 67 stage groups.  It
ran each file in a private writable stage copy with read-only sibling links:
1,000 tests passed.  Stage 70 retained one raw failure (13 pass, 1 fail)
because a non-unique exact KKT witness has a noncanonical stored hash.  Fresh
recomputation differs only at that hash field; all substantive matrices,
spectra, nullities, polynomial identities, kernel witnesses, and exact
verification flags agree.  No skip, xfail, source rewrite, or suppression was
used.

These executions support finite/restricted source claims only.  They do not
construct continuum Yang--Mills, complete Osterwalder--Schrader
reconstruction, establish theory identity, or prove a Hamiltonian mass gap.

## Reproduce the integration checks

```bash
.venv/bin/python agentic/scripts/integrate_ym_representational_dynamics_20260721.py --refresh-normalized --require-literature-after 2026-07-21 --theory-state-digest <canonical-state-digest>
.venv/bin/python agentic/scripts/replay_ym_representational_dynamics_20260721.py
.venv/bin/python agentic/scripts/validate_ym_representational_dynamics_20260721.py --allow-open-todos
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_ym_representational_dynamics_20260721.py
```
